description.value: Pointage Bakery is a small-batch artisan bread shop in Richmond, BC, founded by Vivian after training in French boulangerie at Le Cordon Bleu Japan. The name 'Pointage' refers to the fermentation stage of bread-making, reflecting the bakery's philosophy of patience, natural ingredients, and no preservatives. Items such as Mentaiko Baguette, Double Matcha Bagel, and a curated Weekly Bread Surprise Box are available for pre-order.

bike_parking_detail: 2 racks within 100m: rack (covered) at 7m; rack (covered) at 10m.

enrichment_extras.reasoning: The website is live and confirms the business name, address (#130-8311 Westminster Highway, Richmond, BC V6X 1A7), and email (info@pointagebakery.com) matching OSM. The store page reveals that Pointage Bakery operates on a pre-order, Saturday-pickup-only model with very limited pickup windows, which is unusual for a walk-in retail bakery. No mention of bike parking, water refill, washrooms, or any cycling-specific amenities appears anywhere on the site.
concerns: Bakery appears to operate as a pre-order, Saturday-pickup-only model rather than a traditional walk-in retail shop — spontaneous visitors may find it closed or unable to purchase on-site without a prior order.
No phone number is listed in OSM or on the website.
enrichment_extras.recommended_status_reason: A real, operating artisan bakery with a confirmed address and active website; useful to touring cyclists seeking food stops in Richmond.

wow_evidence: pre-order, Saturday-pickup-only model with very limited pickup windows
